title: Int’l Cultural & Creative Industry Expo opens in Beijing
description:
The Beijing International Cultural & Creative Industry Expo kicked off Thursday morning in China's capital. Celebrating its 10th anniversary, the event features all kinds of smart designs and fine art, alongside high-tech digital exhibits. CCTV reporter Shen Li went along to check out the latest gizmos that aim to make life more fun and convenient.
